specification_purpose: Rotate the confirmatory execution path's canonical digest after the unreachable duplicate rollback block of src/v2_confirmatory/runner.py was removed, and carry the rotation by reference so that no frozen artifact is edited.

change.unreachability_proof: The block followed the raise statement of the same except handler, so no control path reaches it; it duplicated the rollback statements that run before that raise.
change.behavioural_change_proof: Only unreachable statements were removed, so every reachable statement, every write, every abort path and every exposure rule is unchanged.
change.reason: The audit found the block and refused an in-place edit, because the execution path's digest is bound by the authorization and the runbook.

precedence.rule: Where an amended artifact records a code identity that differs from this amendment, this amendment governs the code-identity fields only; every other field of the amended artifacts stands unchanged.

corrections.claim: the confirmatory protocol and its criterion amendment bind the confirmatory execution path's digest
corrections.evidence: Neither configs/research_v2_confirmatory_protocol.json nor configs/research_v2_confirmatory_protocol_amendment_1.json records an execution-path digest: their code-hash constraint covers the hashed set src/breakout_research only. The audit's attribution was one file too wide; the artifacts that bind the execution-path digest are the authorization and the runbook.
corrections.corrected_by: this amendment; neither artifact is edited

resolution_rule.rule: The effective execution-path digest is the digest the authorization records when the tree is still the tree the authorization froze; otherwise it is the digest this amendment records, and only when this amendment hash-verifies and binds the current tree.
checks: the hashed set's canonical digest equals the recorded one; the hashed set may never change
the recorded execution-path digest equals the live one, or this amendment rotates exactly that digest to the live one
the recorded composite run identity equals the composite of the two live digests
the amendment's own manifest hash recomputes
resolution_rule.a_mismatch_is_never_an_environment_fact: The checkout-dependent ordered digest compute_code_hash() is an environment fact and is never an identity; a canonical-digest mismatch is a real drift and refuses the run.

durability.rule: The amendment takes effect when this artifact is committed. No confirmatory-window candle may be read before the commit that carries this artifact, the authorization and the runbook exists.
durability.note: The commit hash is recorded by the committing session. This artifact is not rewritten after that commit, because its manifest_hash must not change.

hashing.note: manifest_hash is the sha256 of the document body with manifest_hash removed, so the document does not hash itself into a cycle.
